name: Calendar
description: The current calendar

name: TimeZone
description: The current time zone

name: __delta_only_variant_encoding_enabled
description: Enables the Parquet reader to identify a Variant structurally.

name: access_mode
description: Access mode of the database (AUTOMATIC, READ_ONLY or READ_WRITE)

name: allocator_background_threads
description: Whether to enable the allocator background thread.

name: allocator_bulk_deallocation_flush_threshold
description: If a bulk deallocation larger than this occurs, flush outstanding allocations.

name: allocator_flush_threshold
description: Peak allocation threshold at which to flush the allocator after completing a task.

name: allow_asterisks_in_http_paths
description: Allow '*' character in URLs users can query

name: allow_community_extensions
description: Allow to load community built extensions

name: allow_extensions_metadata_mismatch
description: Allow to load extensions with not compatible metadata

name: allow_parser_override_extension
description: Allow extensions to override the current parser

name: allow_persistent_secrets
description: Allow the creation of persistent secrets, that are stored and loaded on restarts

name: allow_unredacted_secrets
description: Allow printing unredacted secrets

name: allow_unsigned_extensions
description: Allow to load extensions with invalid or missing signatures

name: allowed_configs
description: List of configuration options that are ALWAYS allowed to be changed - even when lock_configuration is true

name: allowed_directories
description: List of directories/prefixes that are ALWAYS allowed to be queried - even when enable_external_access is false

name: allowed_paths
description: List of files that are ALWAYS allowed to be queried - even when enable_external_access is false

name: arrow_large_buffer_size
description: Whether Arrow buffers for strings, blobs, uuids and bits should be exported using large buffers

name: arrow_lossless_conversion
description: Whenever a DuckDB type does not have a clear native or canonical extension match in Arrow, export the types with a duckdb.type_name extension name.

name: arrow_output_list_view
description: Whether export to Arrow format should use ListView as the physical layout for LIST columns

name: arrow_output_version
description: Whether strings should be produced by DuckDB in Utf8View format instead of Utf8

name: asof_loop_join_threshold
description: The maximum number of rows we need on the left side of an ASOF join to use a nested loop join

name: auto_checkpoint_skip_wal_threshold
description: The estimated WAL write size at which point we will skip writing to the WAL and only checkpoint. Skipping writing to the WAL means concurrent commits are blocked while the checkpoint is happening.

name: auto_fallback_to_full_download
description: Allows automatically falling back to full file downloads when possible.

name: autoinstall_extension_repository
description: Overrides the custom endpoint for extension installation on autoloading

name: autoinstall_known_extensions
description: Whether known extensions are allowed to be automatically installed when a query depends on them

name: autoload_known_extensions
description: Whether known extensions are allowed to be automatically loaded when a query depends on them

name: azure_account_name
description: Azure account name, when set, the extension will attempt to automatically detect credentials

name: azure_context_caching
description: Enable/disable the caching of some context when performing queries. This cache is by default enable, and will for a given connection keep a local context when performing a query. If you suspect that the caching is causing some side effect you can try to disable it by setting this option to false.

name: azure_credential_chain
description: Ordered list of Azure credential providers, in string format separated by ';'. E.g. 'cli;workload_identity;managed_identity;env'

name: azure_endpoint
description: Override the azure endpoint for when the Azure credential providers are used.

name: azure_http_logging
description: Enable Azure HTTP request logging into the DuckDB HTTP log. When true (default), logging follows DuckDB's HTTP log settings (see enable_logging('HTTP')). Set to false to disable Azure HTTP logging.

name: azure_http_logging_redact_headers
description: Semicolon-separated list of header names to redact in HTTP logs (both request and response). Defaults to 'Authorization'.

name: azure_http_logging_redact_query_params
description: Semicolon-separated list of URL query parameter names to redact in HTTP logs. Defaults to 'sig'.

name: azure_http_proxy
description: Proxy to use when login & performing request to azure. By default it will use the HTTP_PROXY environment variable if set.

name: azure_http_stats
description: Include http info from the Azure Storage in the explain analyze statement.

name: azure_proxy_password
description: Http proxy password if needed.

name: azure_proxy_user_name
description: Http proxy user name if needed.

name: azure_read_buffer_size
description: Size of the read buffer. It is recommended that this is evenly divisible by azure_read_transfer_chunk_size.

name: azure_read_transfer_chunk_size
description: Maximum size in bytes that the Azure client will read in a single request. It is recommended that this is a factor of azure_read_buffer_size.

name: azure_read_transfer_concurrency
description: Maximum number of threads the Azure client can use for a single parallel read. If azure_read_transfer_chunk_size is less than azure_read_buffer_size then setting this > 1 will allow the Azure client to do concurrent requests to fill the buffer.

name: azure_storage_connection_string
description: Azure connection string, used for authenticating and configuring azure requests

name: azure_transport_option_type
description: Underlying adapter to use with the Azure SDK. Read more about the adapter at https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-cpp/blob/main/doc/HttpTransportAdapter.md. Valid values are: default, curl

name: azure_write_block_size
description: Size in bytes of each block for Blob/DFS writes. 0 restores the default (8 MiB). Max 4000 MiB (Azure per-request limit). Azure hard-limits a blob to 50,000 blocks; increase this to write files larger than 50,000 × azure_write_block_size bytes.

name: azure_write_staged_blocks_per_commit
description: Number of blocks staged before an intermediate CommitBlockList. 0 (default) disables intermediate commits; the full block list is committed on close. Non-zero values make partial writes visible sooner at the cost of extra commit RPCs. Does not affect the 50,000-block blob limit; increase azure_write_block_size for that.

name: binary_as_string
description: In Parquet files, interpret binary data as a string.

name: block_allocator_memory
description: Physical memory that the block allocator is allowed to use (this memory is never freed and cannot be reduced).

name: ca_cert_file
description: Path to a custom certificate file for self-signed certificates.

name: catalog_error_max_schemas
description: The maximum number of schemas the system will scan for "did you mean..." style errors in the catalog

name: checkpoint_threshold
description: The WAL size threshold at which to automatically trigger a checkpoint (e.g. 1GB)

name: current_transaction_invalidation_policy
description: Which types of exceptions invalidate the database for the current transaction

name: custom_extension_repository
description: Overrides the custom endpoint for remote extension installation

name: custom_profiling_settings
description: Accepts a JSON enabling custom metrics

name: custom_user_agent
description: Metadata from DuckDB callers

name: debug_asof_iejoin
description: DEBUG SETTING: force use of IEJoin to implement AsOf joins

name: debug_checkpoint_abort
description: DEBUG SETTING: trigger an abort while checkpointing for testing purposes

name: debug_checkpoint_sleep_ms
description: DEBUG SETTING: time to sleep before a checkpoint

name: debug_eviction_queue_sleep_micro_seconds
description: DEBUG SETTING: time for the eviction queue to sleep before acquiring shared ownership of block memory

name: debug_force_external
description: DEBUG SETTING: force out-of-core computation for operators that support it, used for testing

name: debug_force_no_cross_product
description: DEBUG SETTING: Force disable cross product generation when hyper graph isn't connected, used for testing

name: debug_physical_table_scan_execution_strategy
description: DEBUG SETTING: force use of given strategy for executing physical table scans

name: debug_skip_checkpoint_on_commit
description: DEBUG SETTING: skip checkpointing on commit

name: debug_verify_blocks
description: DEBUG SETTING: verify block metadata during checkpointing

name: debug_verify_vector
description: DEBUG SETTING: enable vector verification

name: debug_window_mode
description: DEBUG SETTING: switch window mode to use

name: default_block_size
description: The default block size for new duckdb database files (new as-in, they do not yet exist).

name: default_collation
description: The collation setting used when none is specified

name: default_null_order
description: NULL ordering used when none is specified (NULLS_FIRST or NULLS_LAST)

name: default_order
description: The order type used when none is specified (ASC or DESC)

name: default_secret_storage
description: Allows switching the default storage for secrets

name: delta_kernel_logging
description: Forwards the internal logging of the Delta Kernel to the duckdb logger. Warning: this may impact performance even with DuckDB logging disabled.

name: delta_scan_explain_files_filtered
description: Adds the filtered files to the explain output. Warning: this may impact performance of delta scan during explain analyze queries.

name: deprecated_using_key_syntax
description: Configures the use of the deprecated union syntax for USING KEY CTEs.

name: disable_database_invalidation
description: Disables invalidating the database instance when encountering a fatal error. Should be used with great care, as DuckDB cannot guarantee correct behavior after a fatal error.

name: disable_parquet_prefetching
description: Disable the prefetching mechanism in Parquet

name: disable_timestamptz_casts
description: Disable casting from timestamp to timestamptz

name: disabled_compression_methods
description: Disable a specific set of compression methods (comma separated)

name: disabled_filesystems
description: Disable specific file systems preventing access (e.g. LocalFileSystem)

name: disabled_log_types
description: Sets the list of disabled loggers

name: disabled_optimizers
description: DEBUG SETTING: disable a specific set of optimizers (comma separated)

name: duckdb_api
description: DuckDB API surface

name: dynamic_or_filter_threshold
description: The maximum amount of OR filters we generate dynamically from a hash join

name: enable_caching_operators
description: Enables caching operators that cache intermediate results

name: enable_curl_server_cert_verification
description: Enable server side certificate verification for CURL backend.

name: enable_external_access
description: Allow the database to access external state (through e.g. loading/installing modules, COPY TO/FROM, CSV readers, pandas replacement scans, etc)

name: enable_external_file_cache
description: Allow the database to cache external files (e.g., Parquet) in memory.

name: enable_fsst_vectors
description: Allow scans on FSST compressed segments to emit compressed vectors to utilize late decompression

name: enable_geoparquet_conversion
description: Attempt to decode/encode geometry data in/as GeoParquet files if the spatial extension is present.

name: enable_global_s3_configuration
description: Automatically fetch AWS credentials from environment variables.

name: enable_http_logging
description: (deprecated) Enables HTTP logging

name: enable_http_metadata_cache
description: Whether or not the global http metadata is used to cache HTTP metadata

name: enable_logging
description: Enables the logger

name: enable_macro_dependencies
description: Enable created MACROs to create dependencies on the referenced objects (such as tables)

name: enable_object_cache
description: [PLACEHOLDER] Legacy setting - does nothing

name: enable_profiling
description: Enables profiling, and sets the output format (JSON, QUERY_TREE, QUERY_TREE_OPTIMIZER)

name: enable_progress_bar
description: Enables the progress bar, printing progress to the terminal for long queries

name: enable_progress_bar_print
description: Controls the printing of the progress bar, when 'enable_progress_bar' is true

name: enable_server_cert_verification
description: Enable server side certificate verification.

name: enable_view_dependencies
description: Enable created VIEWs to create dependencies on the referenced objects (such as tables)

name: enabled_log_types
description: Sets the list of enabled loggers

name: errors_as_json
description: Output error messages as structured JSON instead of as a raw string

name: experimental_metadata_reuse
description: EXPERIMENTAL: Re-use row group and table metadata when checkpointing.

name: explain_output
description: Output of EXPLAIN statements (ALL, OPTIMIZED_ONLY, PHYSICAL_ONLY)

name: extension_directories
description: Set the directories to store extensions in

name: extension_directory
description: Set the directory to store extensions in

name: external_threads
description: The number of external threads that work on DuckDB tasks.

name: file_search_path
description: A comma separated list of directories to search for input files

name: force_bitpacking_mode
description: DEBUG SETTING: forces a specific bitpacking mode

name: force_column_metadata_reuse
description: Force re-use of row group metadata on a column-level when checkpointing on older storage versions 6 and 7. This breaks storage backward-compatibility with older DuckDB versions.

name: force_compression
description: DEBUG SETTING: forces a specific compression method to be used

name: force_download
description: Forces upfront download of file

name: force_download_threshold
description: Forces upfront download of files smaller than the given size in bytes

name: force_mbedtls_unsafe
description: Enable mbedtls for encryption (WARNING: unsafe to use)

name: force_variant_shredding
description: Forces the VARIANT shredding that happens at checkpoint to use the provided schema for the shredding.

name: geometry_always_xy
description: ignore the defined axis order of coordinate reference systems and always treat them as (easting, northing) instead of e.g. (latitude, longitude)

name: geometry_minimum_shredding_size
description: Minimum size of a rowgroup to enable GEOMETRY shredding, or set to -1 to disable entirely. Defaults to 1/4th of a rowgroup

name: hf_max_per_page
description: Debug option to limit number of items returned in list requests

name: home_directory
description: Sets the home directory used by the system

name: http_keep_alive
description: Keep alive connections. Setting this to false can help when running into connection failures

name: http_logging_output
description: (deprecated) The file to which HTTP logging output should be saved, or empty to print to the terminal

name: http_proxy
description: HTTP proxy host (defaults to the HTTP_PROXY environment variable when unset)

name: http_proxy_password
description: Password for HTTP proxy

name: http_proxy_username
description: Username for HTTP proxy

name: http_retries
description: HTTP retries on I/O error

name: http_retry_backoff
description: Backoff factor for exponentially increasing retry wait time

name: http_retry_wait_ms
description: Time between retries

name: http_timeout
description: HTTP timeout read/write/connection/retry (in seconds)

name: httpfs_client_implementation
description: Select which is the HTTPUtil implementation to be used

name: httpfs_connection_caching
description: Enable connection caching for HTTP requests

name: httpfs_enable_credential_refresh
description: Enable credential refresh for HTTPFS S3 secrets

name: iceberg_logging_post_body_truncate_limit
description: Maximum number of characters of a REST catalog POST body to include in Iceberg log messages. Bodies longer than this are truncated with a trailing '... (truncated)' marker. Set to 0 to omit the body.

name: iceberg_test_force_token_expiry
description: DEBUG SETTING: force OAuth2 token expiry for testing automatic refresh

name: iceberg_use_metadata_log
description: Whether or not to make use of the (optional) 'metadata-log' of a table to ensure atomicity guarantees hold, at the cost of making another GET for json metadata in rare circumstances

name: iceberg_via_aws_sdk_for_catalog_interactions
description: Use legacy code to interact with AWS-based catalogs, via AWS's SDK

name: ieee_floating_point_ops
description: Use IEE754-compliant floating point operations (returning NAN instead of errors/NULL).

name: ignore_row_group_size_for_partitioned_tables
description: Ignore unsupported write.parquet.row-group-size-bytes table property for partitioned tables

name: ignore_target_file_size_for_partitioned_tables
description: Ignore unsupported write.target-file-size-bytes table property for partitioned tables

name: ignore_unknown_crs
description: Ignore unknown Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS) when creating geometry types or importing geospatial data.

name: immediate_transaction_mode
description: Whether transactions should be started lazily when needed, or immediately when BEGIN TRANSACTION is called

name: index_scan_max_count
description: The maximum index scan count sets a threshold for index scans. If fewer than MAX(index_scan_max_count, index_scan_percentage * total_row_count) rows match, we perform an index scan instead of a table scan.

name: index_scan_percentage
description: The index scan percentage sets a threshold for index scans. If fewer than MAX(index_scan_max_count, index_scan_percentage * total_row_count) rows match, we perform an index scan instead of a table scan.

name: integer_division
description: Whether or not the / operator defaults to integer division, or to floating point division

name: lambda_syntax
description: Configures the use of the deprecated single arrow operator (->) for lambda functions.

name: late_materialization_max_rows
description: The maximum amount of rows in the LIMIT/SAMPLE for which we trigger late materialization

name: lock_configuration
description: Whether or not configurations can be altered

name: log_query_path
description: Specifies the path to which queries should be logged (default: NULL, queries are not logged)

name: logging_level
description: The log level which will be recorded in the log

name: logging_mode
description: Determines which types of log messages are logged

name: logging_storage
description: Set the logging storage (memory/stdout/file/<custom>)

name: max_expression_depth
description: The maximum expression depth limit in the parser. WARNING: increasing this setting and using very deep expressions might lead to stack overflow errors.

name: max_memory
description: The maximum memory of the system (e.g. 1GB)

name: max_temp_directory_size
description: The maximum amount of data stored inside the 'temp_directory' (when set) (e.g. 1GB)

name: max_vacuum_tasks
description: The maximum vacuum tasks to schedule during a checkpoint.

name: memory_limit
description: The maximum memory of the system (e.g. 1GB)

name: merge_http_secret_into_s3_request
description: Merges http secret params into S3 requests

name: merge_join_threshold
description: The maximum number of rows on either table to choose a merge join

name: mysql_adaptive_replan_enabled
description: Enable adaptive execution strategy based on actual vs estimated rows (default: true)

name: mysql_aggregate_pushdown_enabled
description: Push aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, etc.) to MySQL (default: true)

name: mysql_allow_results_streaming
description: Whether to allow streaming results of MySQL scans when only a single scan used in a query (default: true)

name: mysql_bit1_as_boolean
description: Whether or not to convert BIT(1) columns to BOOLEAN

name: mysql_compression_aware_costs
description: Apply compression ratios when estimating transfer costs (default: true)

name: mysql_compression_ratio
description: Compression ratio for transfer cost estimation (default: 0.7)

name: mysql_debug_show_queries
description: DEBUG SETTING: print all queries sent to MySQL to stdout

name: mysql_enable_predicate_analyzer
description: Whether or not to use predicate analyzer with cost-based pushdowns

name: mysql_enable_transactions
description: Whether to run 'START TRANSACTION'/'COMMIT'/'ROLLBACK' on MySQL connections

name: mysql_experimental_filter_pushdown
description: Whether or not to use filter pushdown (without predicate analyzer)

name: mysql_explain_validation_enabled
description: Validate MySQL execution plans with EXPLAIN (default: false)

name: mysql_hint_injection_enabled
description: Inject MySQL optimizer hints when statistics appear stale (default: false)

name: mysql_hint_staleness_threshold
description: Staleness score threshold for injecting optimizer hints (default: 0.5)

name: mysql_incomplete_dates_as_nulls
description: Whether to return DATEs with zero month or day as NULLs

name: mysql_order_pushdown_enabled
description: Push ORDER BY and LIMIT clauses to MySQL (default: true)

name: mysql_pool_acquire_mode
description: How to acquire connections from the pool: 'force' (always connect, ignore pool limit), 'wait' (block until available), 'try' (fail immediately if unavailable) (default: force)

name: mysql_pool_connection_idle_timeout_millis
description: Maximum time in milliseconds a connection can sit idle in the cache before being closed (default: 60000 - disabled)

name: mysql_pool_connection_max_lifetime_millis
description: Maximum age in milliseconds of a pooled connection since it was first opened. When exceeded, the connection is closed instead of being returned to the cache (default: 0 - disabled)

name: mysql_pool_enable_reaper_thread
description: Whether to run a dedicated thread that periodically scans the pool and removes expired connections (default: true)

name: mysql_pool_enable_thread_local_cache
description: Enable thread-local connection caching for faster same-thread connection reuse (default: false)

name: mysql_pool_size
description: Maximum number of connections per MySQL catalog (default: min(cpu_count, 4 <= cpu_count * 1.5 <= 32))

name: mysql_pool_wait_timeout_millis
description: Timeout in milliseconds when waiting for a connection from the pool (default: 30000)

name: mysql_push_threshold_no_index
description: Selectivity threshold for pushing filters without index support (default: 0.3)

name: mysql_push_threshold_with_index
description: Selectivity threshold for pushing filters with index support (default: 0.5)

name: mysql_query_timeout_enabled
description: Add MAX_EXECUTION_TIME hint to MySQL queries for safety (default: true)

name: mysql_query_timeout_max_ms
description: Maximum query timeout in milliseconds (default: 300000)

name: mysql_query_timeout_min_ms
description: Minimum query timeout in milliseconds (default: 5000)

name: mysql_session_time_zone
description: Value to use as a session time zone for newly opened connections to MySQL server

name: mysql_sql_buffer_result
description: Add SQL_BUFFER_RESULT for large result sets to release row locks faster (default: true)

name: mysql_time_as_time
description: Whether or not to convert MySQL's TIME columns to DuckDB's TIME

name: mysql_tinyint1_as_boolean
description: Whether or not to convert TINYINT(1) columns to BOOLEAN

name: nested_loop_join_threshold
description: The maximum number of rows on either table to choose a nested loop join

name: null_order
description: NULL ordering used when none is specified (NULLS_FIRST or NULLS_LAST)

name: old_implicit_casting
description: Allow implicit casting to/from VARCHAR

name: order_by_non_integer_literal
description: Allow ordering by non-integer literals - ordering by such literals has no effect.

name: ordered_aggregate_threshold
description: The number of rows to accumulate before sorting, used for tuning

name: pandas_analyze_sample
description: The maximum number of rows to sample when analyzing a pandas object column.

name: parquet_metadata_cache
description: Cache Parquet metadata - useful when reading the same files multiple times

name: partitioned_write_flush_threshold
description: The threshold in number of rows after which we flush a thread state when writing using PARTITION_BY

name: partitioned_write_max_open_files
description: The maximum amount of files the system can keep open before flushing to disk when writing using PARTITION_BY

name: password
description: The password to use. Ignored for legacy compatibility.

name: perfect_ht_threshold
description: Threshold in bytes for when to use a perfect hash table

name: pg_array_as_varchar
description: Read Postgres arrays as varchar - enables reading mixed dimensional arrays

name: pg_connection_cache
description: Whether or not to use the connection pooling. This option is deprecated, instead to disable the connection pooling use "SET pg_pool_max_connections=0" for newly attached Postgres databases and "FROM postgres_configure_pool(catalog_name='my_attached_postgres_db', max_connections=0)" for already attached Postgres databases.

name: pg_connection_limit
description: The maximum amount of concurrent Postgres connections. This option is deprecated, instead use "SET pg_pool_max_connections = 42" for newly attached Postgres databases and "FROM postgres_configure_pool(catalog_name='my_attached_postgres_db', max_connections=42)" for already attached Postgres databases.

name: pg_debug_show_queries
description: DEBUG SETTING: print all queries sent to Postgres to stdout

name: pg_experimental_filter_pushdown
description: Whether or not to use filter pushdown

name: pg_idle_in_transaction_timeout_millis
description: Postgres idle in transaction timeout in milliseconds to set on scan connections

name: pg_null_byte_replacement
description: When writing NULL bytes to Postgres, replace them with the given character

name: pg_oauth_token
description: OAuth bearer token for PostgreSQL OAUTHBEARER authentication. Takes priority over the PGOAUTHTOKEN environment variable

name: pg_pages_per_task
description: The amount of pages per task

name: pg_pool_acquire_mode
description: How to acquire connections from the pool: 'force' (always connect, ignore pool limit), 'wait' (block until available), 'try' (fail immediately if unavailable) (default: force)

name: pg_pool_enable_reaper_thread
description: Whether to enable the connection pool reaper thread, that periodically scans the pool to check the 'max_lifetime_millis' and 'idle_timeout_millis' and closes the connection which exceed the specified values. Either 'max_lifetime_millis' or 'idle_timeout_millis' must be set to a non-zero value for this option to be effective. This option only applies to newly attached Postgres databases, to configure a database that is already attached use "FROM postgres_configure_pool(catalog_name='my_attached_postgres_db', enable_reaper_thread=TRUE)"

name: pg_pool_enable_thread_local_cache
description: Whether to enable the connection caching in thread-local cache. Such connections are getting pinned to the threads and are not made available to other threads, while still taking the place in the pool. This option only applies to newly attached Postgres databases, to configure a database that is already attached use "FROM postgres_configure_pool(catalog_name='my_attached_postgres_db', enable_thread_local_cache=FALSE)"

name: pg_pool_health_check_query
description: The query that is used to check that the connection is healthy. Setting this option to an empty string disables the health check. This option only applies to newly attached Postgres databases, to configure a database that is already attached use "FROM postgres_configure_pool(catalog_name='my_attached_postgres_db', health_check_query=SELECT 42)"

name: pg_pool_idle_timeout_millis
description: Maximum number of milliseconds the connection can be kept idle in the pool. This number is checked when the connection is taken from the pool. When the connection pool reaper thread is enabled ('pg_pool_enable_reaper_thread' option), then this number is checked in background periodically. This option only applies to newly attached Postgres databases, to configure a database that is already attached use "FROM postgres_configure_pool(catalog_name='my_attached_postgres_db', idle_timeout_millis=300000)"

name: pg_pool_max_connections
description: Maximum number of connections that are allowed to be cached in a connection pool for each attached Postgres database. This number can be temporary exceeded when parallel scans are used. This option only applies to newly attached Postgres databases, to configure a database that is already attached use "FROM postgres_configure_pool(catalog_name='my_attached_postgres_db', max_connections=42)"

name: pg_pool_max_lifetime_millis
description: Maximum number of milliseconds the connection can be kept open. This number is checked when the connection is taken from the pool and returned to the pool. When the connection pool reaper thread is enabled ('pg_pool_enable_reaper_thread' option), then this number is checked in background periodically. This option only applies to newly attached Postgres databases, to configure a database that is already attached use "FROM postgres_configure_pool(catalog_name='my_attached_postgres_db', max_lifetime_millis=600000)"

name: pg_pool_wait_timeout_millis
description: Maximum number of milliseconds to wait when acquiring a connection from a pool where all available connections are already taken. This option only applies to newly attached Postgres databases, to configure a database that is already attached use "FROM postgres_configure_pool(catalog_name='my_attached_postgres_db', wait_timeout_millis=60000)"

name: pg_staleness_query
description: Custom query used in place of the default table staleness query when pg_staleness_query_enabled resolves to true. Must contain a ${SCHEMA} placeholder and return at least 3 columns (identity, name, revision marker). Empty (default) uses the built-in pg_class/xmin query.

name: pg_staleness_query_enabled
description: Whether or not the table catalog cache checks Postgres for external DDL changes before serving a cache hit. Defaults to the opposite of pg_use_information_schema_introspection when not explicitly set (off for pg protocol compatible databases that may not support the underlying query, on for Postgres).

name: pg_statement_timeout_millis
description: Postgres statement timeout in milliseconds to set on scan connections

name: pg_use_binary_copy
description: Whether or not to use BINARY copy to read data

name: pg_use_ctid_scan
description: Whether or not to parallelize scanning using table ctids

name: pg_use_information_schema_introspection
description: Use SQL-standard information_schema views for ATTACH-time schema discovery instead of pg_catalog.For compatibility with pg protocol compatible databases like spanner, cockroach, redshift, ...

name: pg_use_text_protocol
description: Whether or not to use TEXT protocol to read data. This is slower, but provides better compatibility with non-Postgres systems

name: pin_threads
description: Whether to pin threads to cores (Linux only, default AUTO: on when there are more than 64 cores)

name: pivot_filter_threshold
description: The threshold to switch from using filtered aggregates to LIST with a dedicated pivot operator

name: pivot_limit
description: The maximum number of pivot columns in a pivot statement

name: prefer_range_joins
description: Force use of range joins with mixed predicates

name: prefetch_all_parquet_files
description: Use the prefetching mechanism for all types of parquet files

name: preserve_identifier_case
description: Whether or not to preserve the identifier case, instead of always lowercasing all non-quoted identifiers

name: preserve_insertion_order
description: Whether or not to preserve insertion order. If set to false the system is allowed to re-order any results that do not contain ORDER BY clauses.

name: produce_arrow_string_view
description: Whether Arrow strings should be produced by DuckDB in Utf8View format instead of Utf8

name: profile_output
description: The file to which profile output should be saved, or empty to print to the terminal

name: profiling_coverage
description: The profiling coverage (SELECT or ALL)

name: profiling_mode
description: The profiling mode (STANDARD or DETAILED)

name: profiling_output
description: The file to which profile output should be saved, or empty to print to the terminal

name: progress_bar_time
description: Sets the time (in milliseconds) how long a query needs to take before we start printing a progress bar

name: python_enable_replacements
description: Whether variables visible to the current stack should be used for replacement scans.

name: python_scan_all_frames
description: If set, restores the old behavior of scanning all preceding frames to locate the referenced variable.

name: rtree_index_scan_min_rows
description: always allow an R-tree index scan when the estimated number of matching rows is at or below this count, regardless of rtree_index_scan_ratio

name: rtree_index_scan_ratio
description: the maximum estimated fraction of a table's rows that a bounding-box filter may match for an R-tree index scan to be used instead of a full table scan

name: s3_access_key_id
description: S3 Access Key ID

name: s3_allow_recursive_globbing
description: Whether globs on S3-like storage are optimized with recursive strategy (alterative is listing)

name: s3_endpoint
description: S3 Endpoint

name: s3_kms_key_id
description: S3 KMS Key ID

name: s3_region
description: S3 Region

name: s3_requester_pays
description: S3 use requester pays mode

name: s3_secret_access_key
description: S3 Access Key

name: s3_session_token
description: S3 Session Token

name: s3_uploader_max_filesize
description: S3 Uploader max filesize (between 50GB and 5TB)

name: s3_uploader_max_parts_per_file
description: S3 Uploader max parts per file (between 1 and 10000)

name: s3_uploader_thread_limit
description: S3 Uploader global thread limit

name: s3_url_compatibility_mode
description: Disable Globs and Query Parameters on S3 URLs

name: s3_url_style
description: S3 URL style

name: s3_use_ssl
description: S3 use SSL

name: s3_version_id_pinning
description: Pin S3 reads to a specific object version for consistency

name: scalar_subquery_error_on_multiple_rows
description: When a scalar subquery returns multiple rows - return a random row instead of returning an error.

name: scheduler_process_partial
description: Partially process tasks before rescheduling - allows for more scheduler fairness between separate queries

name: schema
description: Sets the default search schema. Equivalent to setting search_path to a single value.

name: search_path
description: Sets the default catalog search path as a comma-separated list of values

name: secret_directory
description: Set the directory to which persistent secrets are stored

name: storage_block_prefetch
description: In which scenarios to use storage block prefetching

name: storage_compatibility_version
description: Serialize on checkpoint with compatibility for a given duckdb version

name: streaming_buffer_size
description: The maximum memory to buffer between fetching from a streaming result (e.g. 1GB)

name: temp_directory
description: Set the directory to which to write temp files

name: temp_file_encryption
description: Encrypt all temporary files if database is encrypted

name: threads
description: The number of total threads used by the system.

name: unsafe_disable_etag_checks
description: Disable checks on ETag consistency

name: unsafe_enable_version_guessing
description: Enable globbing the filesystem (if possible) to find the latest version metadata. This could result in reading an uncommitted version.

name: unsafe_iceberg_ignore_sort_order
description: Allow INSERT/UPDATE on iceberg tables that declare a sort order, without applying that sort order to the written data. The Iceberg spec permits this (writers are not required to honour a declared sort order, and readers do not assume files are sorted), but skipping the sort may reduce later file-pruning effectiveness and compression.

name: user
description: The username to use. Ignored for legacy compatibility.

name: username
description: The username to use. Ignored for legacy compatibility.

name: vacuum_rebuild_indexes
description: (Experimental) Allow vacuum to compact row groups on tables with bound ART indexes, rebuilding the indexes afterward. Tables with a row count exceeding this threshold are skipped. 0 = disabled. Can also be set per-database via the 'vacuum_rebuild_indexes' ATTACH option, which overrides this default.

name: validate_external_file_cache
description: Cache validation mode: VALIDATE_ALL (default, validate all cache entries), VALIDATE_REMOTE (validate only remote cache entries), or NO_VALIDATION (disable cache validation).

name: variant_minimum_shredding_size
description: Minimum size of a rowgroup to enable VARIANT shredding, or set to -1 to disable entirely. Defaults to 1/4th of a rowgroup

name: wal_autocheckpoint
description: The WAL size threshold at which to automatically trigger a checkpoint (e.g. 1GB)

name: wal_autocheckpoint_entries
description: Trigger automatic checkpoint when WAL entry count reaches or exceeds N (0 = disabled)

name: warnings_as_errors
description: Escalate all warnings to errors.

name: worker_threads
description: The number of total threads used by the system.

name: write_buffer_row_group_count
description: The amount of row groups to buffer in bulk ingestion prior to flushing them together. Reducing this setting can reduce memory consumption.

name: write_buffer_row_group_memory_limit
description: The maximum data to buffer in row groups (in bytes) to buffer prior to flushing them together. When either this limit is reached, or write_buffer_row_group_count is reached, we flush the data to disk. Defaults to 20% of memory limit divided by thread count.

name: zstd_min_string_length
description: The (average) length at which to enable ZSTD compression, defaults to 4096
